title: NeuroBridge: Bio-Inspired Self-Supervised EEG-to-Image Decoding via Cognitive Priors and Bidirectional Semantic Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2511.06836v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual neural decoding seeks to reconstruct or infer perceived visual stimuli from brain activity patterns, providing critical insights into human cognition and enabling transformative applications in brain-computer interfaces and artificial intelligence. Current approaches, however, remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality stimulus-brain response pairs and the inherent semantic mismatch between neural representations and visual content. Inspired by perceptual variability and co-adaptive strategy of the biological systems, we propose a novel self-supervised architecture, named NeuroBridge, which integrates Cognitive Prior Augmentation (CPA) with Shared Semantic Projector (SSP) to promote effective cross-modality alignment. tldr: 该论文提出NeuroBridge，一种受生物启发的自监督EEG到图像解码架构，通过认知先验增强（CPA）与共享语义投影器（SSP）实现有效的跨模态语义对齐，解决了高质量刺激-大脑响应对稀缺以及神经表征与视觉内容之间语义不匹配的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NeuroBridge, a bio-inspired self-supervised EEG-to-image decoding architecture that integrates Cognitive Prior Augmentation (CPA) with a Shared Semantic Projector (SSP) to achieve effective cross-modal alignment, addressing the scarcity of high-quality stimulus-brain response pairs and the semantic mismatch between neural representations and visual content.
